title: Preserved periodic-copy shift gives a misleading geometry error
steps: Increase a periodic images to two
Click the displayed periodic copy in Measure mode
Switch to Edit, preserving the measurement
Click the existing Shift Selected button
expected: Periodic copies cannot be moved; clear the measurement or make a supercell first.
actual: Shift cannot be represented in this cell
rootCause: The shift adapter passed a display-copy selection ID to a document-index command; generic geometry validation rejected it without an editability diagnosis. The target hint incorrectly promised to shift the copy.
limitation: This is an incorrect hint/error diagnosis, not evidence of document corruption.
